description: Header file defining classes and functions for file system operations, including file handling, directory management, and partition information, within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with methods for creation, opening, reading, writing, and attribute management.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory with methods for creation, traversal, deletion, and attribute management.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Provides information about disk partitions, including size, free space, and mount points.

methods.name: ParsePathInfo
methods.description: Parses a path info string into path and permission components.

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes file or directory paths.

methods.name: FileName
methods.description: Extracts the filename from a path.

methods.name: FileNameExtended
methods.description: Returns the extended filename including extension.

methods.name: PathName
methods.description: Extracts the directory path from a full filename.

methods.name: IsPathAbsolute
methods.description: Checks if a given path is absolute.

methods.name: Extension
methods.description: Returns the file extension.

methods.name: ErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the last error code for file operations.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the file is currently open.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if the file exists.

methods.name: IsReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if the file is read-only.

methods.name: IsHidden
methods.description: Checks if the file is hidden.

methods.name: IsSystem
methods.description: Checks if the file is a system file.

methods.name: IsArchive
methods.description: Checks if the file is marked as archive.

methods.name: IsDirectory
methods.description: Checks if the file is a directory.

methods.name: IsLink
methods.description: Checks if the file is a symbolic link.

methods.name: IsCompressed
methods.description: Checks if the file is compressed (Windows only).

methods.name: IsEncrypted
methods.description: Checks if the file is encrypted (Windows only).

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the file.

methods.name: ModificationTime
methods.description: Returns the last modification time.

methods.name: AccessTime
methods.description: Returns the last access time.

methods.name: CreationTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: SetSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new file.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the file.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Opens the file for appending.

methods.name: Unlink
methods.description: Deletes the file.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Deletes the file permanently.

methods.name: Move
methods.description: Moves/renames the file.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the file.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the file.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the file.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Sets or gets the file pointer position.

methods.name: DuplicateHandle
methods.description: Duplicates the file handle.
